services.name: School Tours
services.desc: Your classroom curriculum will be enriched through our inquiry-based tours and our design-based activities that not only turn abstract concepts into real-world applications but also align with California curriculum standards. Join our Museum Educators on a 75-minute interactive road trip around the museum to explore the history and science of the automobile. Our Educators will guide your students through fun STEAM-based activities to help facilitate learning. Our K-12 tours are designed to be customizable to best fit your classroom needs. You will receive an email from our School’s Coordinator at bpdailla@petersen.org with information about booking, a scheduling packet, & school form.
